# Vendored MapLibre GL JS

Version: 6.16.0, from the published `maplibre-gl` npm package.

- `maplibre-gl.mjs`: browser ES module
- `maplibre-gl-worker.mjs`: browser module worker
- `maplibre-gl.css`: map UI stylesheet
- `MAPLIBRE-LICENSE.txt`: BSD-3-Clause license

Source: https://github.com/maplibre/maplibre-gl-js
Documentation: https://maplibre.org/maplibre-gl-js/docs/

Only trailing source-map references were removed; source maps are not shipped. Runtime modules are bundled, so npm is not needed to serve this directory. Keep the license when distributing these files.
